info.description: Enterprise-grade E2E Postman Suite for the IT Operation Window Service Domain (BIAN-aligned, ADR-001/005/013/018). Covers the Operation Window lifecycle under /it-operation-window/v1 (initiate, retrieve, reschedule, control/start|complete|cancel), the collision dry-run (collision-check/evaluate) with its impact report, the half-open interval semantics, the subordinate maintenance-ticket resource under /it-operation-window/v1/maintenance-ticket, mandatory X-Tenant-Id/X-Executor auditing, and RFC 7807 error_code assertions (400/404/409, including the ERR-COL-00409 problem carrying the `conflicts` extension). Requires an organisationId environment variable populated from the Party Reference Data Directory Service Domain; every scheduling variable is computed by pre-request scripts relative to now + 60 days.
